term: law consistency, conditional uniqueness, represented realization, actuality and warrant
resolution: Follows witnesses consistency of a supplied rule; uniqueness quantifies over traces satisfying THAT rule, not rival laws. realized supplies exact state presence inside a mathematical interpretation. Neither Type inhabitation nor that represented population establishes actual concrete existence or governing efficacy. UsesRecord/Identifies concern exact uniform law identification from a finite prefix, not epistemic entitlement. A warranted restriction to one law or extra evidence may remove the counterexample; the theorem does not make the synthetic rival metaphysically possible. Unexplained stable laws need not yield inaccurate predictions; necessary impersonal nature, dispositional essences and best-system selection remain positive proposals with distinct actuality/access obligations.
